prompt:
Fantasy trading-card illustration in the style of early-to-mid 1990s card art: hand-made traditional media (gouache, acrylic, watercolour and pen-and-ink), visible brushstrokes and pen lines, matte paper texture, and the slightly soft, faded look of a card printed in the 1990s. Expressive and a little stylised rather than realistic: strong shapes, bold silhouettes, sometimes inked outlines and flat patterned colour. Dark overall with near-black shadows, lit by bold, saturated accent colours taken from the card's own light and colour key (no default orange) where they matter. Frame the subject tightly: it fills most of the picture and may be cropped by the edges, with its face or focal point near the centre; keep the background minimal, simple and dark. Landscape 3:2 composition. No text, no letters, no border, no card frame, no logo, no watermark, no signature. Not photorealistic, not 3D render, not modern digital concept art, not anime.

Norse look for this hero: the same 1990s hand-made card art, but colder and harder than the Greek cards. Heavier, rougher black ink lines with a carved, woodcut-like quality, as if cut into wood or stone; flat areas of colour broken by scratchy hatching. A northern palette of slate blue, iron grey, bone white and deep pine green, with sparing accents of blood red and dull, tarnished gold; no warm Mediterranean light, no sunsets, no bronze glow. Weather matters: snow, sleet, sea-spray, mist and long winter dusk. Where the picture shows objects, give them Viking Age ornament: interlaced beasts and knotwork carved on wood, iron and runestones in the Urnes and Mammen styles, and the look of the Gotland picture-stones. People are weathered and heavy, in wool, fur, leather and iron; no horned helmets, no winged helmets, no fantasy plate armour.

Setting: Viking Age Norse myth: iron mail, round wooden shields, furs, runestones, longhalls, ravens, wolves, fjords, snow and northern sky.

Subject: Brynhild the valkyrie from the Volsunga saga, who defied Odin and was cast into an enchanted sleep inside a ring of fire on the mountain Hindarfjall: she stands awake at the heart of the wall of flame in a long iron mail byrnie and a plain iron helmet, gripping a spear and a round painted shield, her pale braids lifting in the heat, the fire ring closing around her on a dark snowy peak.

Composition: a monumental full figure, seen from a very low angle. Light and colour: roaring firelight against a black, snowy mountain night. Presence: larger than life, monumental and iconic, lit by a cold rim of lightning or aurora; the most dramatic kind of image in the set. The subject fills most of the picture; keep the background minimal.
